There are two kinds of mathematics.
https://blossom.yakihonne.com/0e663628f1faac051ea92fd06aecf7e9fc8c9dc8506edd88b9166b214635c9d1.jpeg
Mathematics as institutional signalling proves that you belong: credentials, models, committees, forecasts, and equations whose authority depends on the institution presenting them.

Mathematics as architecture of survival must continue working when trust disappears, incentives turn hostile, and every participant is free to attack the system.

That is the fiat–Bitcoin distinction.

Fiat uses mathematics to describe, justify, and manage policy. Its numbers remain subordinate to political discretion. The ledger can be expanded, the rules rewritten, and losses reassigned.

Bitcoin uses mathematics to constrain power.

Hashing, proof of work, difficulty adjustment, signatures, and distributed validation are not academic decoration. They form an adversarial survival architecture. The equations do not ask who is prestigious, licensed, elected, or institutionally approved.

They ask only:

Is the proof valid?

Fiat mathematics signals authority.

Bitcoin mathematics survives authority. 

The core line is: Fiat uses mathematics to legitimise discretion; Bitcoin uses mathematics to limit it.
